explain.kvah: kVAh is the total electricity your factory drew, including the part that does no useful work. HT bills are charged in kVAh.
explain.pf: Power factor is kWh divided by kVAh. Close to 1 is good. Below 0.90 can add a penalty to your bill.
explain.mdKva: Maximum demand is the highest load your factory reached in the month. Demand charges are based on it.
